rationale: The agent did not follow key policy steps. Based on the tool calls, it: (1) did not authenticate the user beyond looking up by email; (2) executed returns (order-changing writes) without explicit prior confirmation; (3) refunded to the original payment methods rather than the opposite methods requested; and (4) only escalated to a human after acting contrary to the user’s request. Even if refunding to a different method isn’t possible, the agent should have explained limits and obtained consent before proceeding. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
